Don't trust a lone identity. New agents can't pop up like a comet. Every newcomer links to a verified referrer, 100 units locked 12 epochs.

Your referrer is your lantern: clean history vouches. One referrer backs at most 3 per epoch. No jetty, no entry: you can't dock without one.

If you're fake, the chain freezes and your referrer can't vouch 10 epochs. 1,000 clones need 34 referrers locking 3,400 units, and a 40% catch rate costs you 13,600 units.
